helpers.name: Vlasov.finiteRange_approxMap_measurable
helpers.one_line_math: Given a measurable disjoint partition As covering univ with representatives as, the truncated step map T (x = as n if x in As n for n < N, else x0) is measurable with finite range; uses piecewise-measurability of indicator-indexed functions.

helpers.name: Vlasov.lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_of_integrable_nonneg
helpers.one_line_math: Integrable f + ae-nonneg implies the lintegral of ENNReal.ofReal(f) is finite (not top); extracted from hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal.

helpers.name: Vlasov.lintegral_ofReal_tail_tendsto_zero
helpers.one_line_math: If integral of ofReal(f) is finite and the measure of (S n)^c tends to zero, then the integral of ofReal(f) over (S n)^c also tends to zero (absolute continuity of the Lebesgue integral).

helpers.name: Vlasov.lintegral_ofReal_kept_cells_le
helpers.one_line_math: If c(x, T x) <= delta for all x in the N kept cells and mu is a probability measure, then the lintegral of ofReal(c(x, T x)) over the kept cells union is at most ofReal(delta).
helpers.proof_sketch: apply lintegral_biUnion_finset + on each cell use lintegral_mono then bound by delta * mu(As n); sum over n < N uses mu(univ) = 1

residual_glue.strategy: Get dist-diameter partition via SeparableSpace.exists_measurable_partition_diam_le; build finiteRange map; show lintegral ofReal(c x0) is finite; extract N making tail cost <= eps/2 via ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero; decompose total via lintegral_add_compl; kept cells via lintegral_ofReal_kept_cells_le (residual sorry: establish c(x, T x) <= eps/2 from diameter bound - needs hc_le_dist or c-ball partition); tail via hN.
residual_glue.tactic_sketch: haveI := inferInstance; obtain As partition; have hfint from helper; extract N; obtain T from finiteRange helper; rw lintegral_add_compl; gcongr; [apply lintegral_ofReal_kept_cells_le; sorry (c vs dist gap)], [setLIntegral_congr_fun + hN]
